models.source: SELECT value raw,(ordinality-1)::int model_position FROM jsonb_array_elements($3::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY

seasons.source: WITH models AS (SELECT value raw,(ordinality-1)::int model_position FROM jsonb_array_elements($3::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY), seasons AS (SELECT m.model_position,s.value raw,(s.ordinality-1)::int season_position FROM models m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(m.raw->'seasons','[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY s) SELECT * FROM seasons

weekdays.source: WITH models AS (SELECT value raw,(ordinality-1)::int model_position FROM jsonb_array_elements($3::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY), seasons AS (SELECT m.model_position,s.value raw,(s.ordinality-1)::int season_position FROM models m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(m.raw->'seasons','[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY s) SELECT s.model_position,s.season_position,w.key weekday_key,w.value raw FROM seasons s CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(s.raw->'weekdays','{}'::jsonb)) w

blocks.source: WITH models AS (SELECT value raw,(ordinality-1)::int model_position FROM jsonb_array_elements($3::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY), blocks AS (SELECT m.model_position,b.key block_key,b.value raw FROM models m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(m.raw->'blocks','{}'::jsonb)) b) SELECT * FROM blocks

block_rows.source: WITH models AS (SELECT value raw,(ordinality-1)::int model_position FROM jsonb_array_elements($3::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY), blocks AS (SELECT m.model_position,b.key block_key,b.value raw FROM models m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(m.raw->'blocks','{}'::jsonb)) b) SELECT b.model_position,b.block_key,(r.ordinality-1)::int row_position,r.value raw FROM blocks b CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(b.raw->'rows','[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY r

schedule_days.source: WITH models AS (SELECT value raw,(ordinality-1)::int model_position FROM jsonb_array_elements($3::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY) SELECT m.model_position,(d.ordinality-1)::int day_position,d.value raw FROM models m CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(m.raw->'days','[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY d
